$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file.

apiVersion.description: The Salesforce REST API version to describe with, e.g. "v66.0". Exported as API_VERSION in the generated file.

output.description: The generated TypeScript file, relative to this config file.

sobjects.description: The sObjects to generate types for. Without it, every queryable sObject is generated.

auth.description: How the generator logs in. Credentials are read from environment variables. Defaults to client credentials from SF_LOGIN_URL, SF_CLIENT_ID and SF_CLIENT_SECRET.

loginUrlEnv.description: Defaults to SF_LOGIN_URL (your My Domain URL).

privateKeyEnv.description: The PEM key itself. Defaults to SF_PRIVATE_KEY.

privateKeyPathEnv.description: A path to the PEM key file. Defaults to SF_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH.

targetOrg.description: The Salesforce CLI org alias or username. Defaults to the CLI's default org.

excludeCreateFields.description: Per sObject, fields to leave out of the create input.

excludeUpdateFields.description: Per sObject, fields to leave out of the update input.

picklists.description: "union" (default): picklists become unions of their values. "string": plain strings. "const": a union plus a named const object and type per picklist, e.g. CaseStatus.Working. "enum": a TypeScript enum per picklist; restricted picklists then only accept enum members.

constants.description: Emit the PICKLIST_VALUES and RECORD_TYPES runtime constants. Defaults to true.

continueOnDescribeError.description: Skip sObjects whose describe fails instead of failing the run. Defaults to false.

importSource.description: Where the generated file imports helper types from. Defaults to "@cerios/salesforce-sobjectly".
